decisions.reason: Requiring multiline headline entry does not change the separate spacing rule for hard returns in continuous text.
The source concerns multiline headline entry, not insertion of line breaks after pasting legacy content.
Multiline entry does not alter help-label language, content, placement, uniqueness, or hover behavior.
Allowing multiple headline lines does not change how placeholder text is cleared when a field is activated.
The source adds a multiline-entry requirement but does not modify the requirement to preserve title-field formatting.
The headline's multiline capability does not change the required visual cue for identifying fillable fields.
The source decision has no effect on approved theme colors or available color choices.
Requiring multiline headline entry does not change the selected mechanism for robust standard text placeholders.
The accepted multiline-entry option does not change the date selector's input method, display format, or scope.
The headline multiline-entry decision does not modify the independently selected checklist control.
The headline multiline-entry decision does not modify the Board Meeting dropdown control.
Supporting multiline headline entry does not change the separate Board Meeting field-alignment requirement.
